question: What unshaken eastern cause lets one enjoy fruit without acting?
premises: without acting he enjoys fruit; the cause there is the eastern unshaken
by action or even by austerity
inference: The unshaken east-cause delivers fruit; yet done action stands by deed or tapas.
plain_english: Without, he enjoys fruit — the cause there is the eastern unshaken; therefore action done, by action or even by austerity.
